description: This file defines functions and types for translating JIT schema to native function APIs in PyTorch, including argument handling, return types, and naming conventions.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Generates a function name string based on FunctionSchema, appending '_out' and overload name if applicable.

methods.name: argumenttype_type
methods.description: Determines the NamedCType for a given argument type, handling tensors, scalars, and optional types.

methods.name: returns_type
methods.description: Determines the CType for function return values based on Return sequence.

methods.name: argument_type
methods.description: Gets the NamedCType for an Argument, SelfArgument, or TensorOptionsArguments.

methods.name: argument
methods.description: Creates a list of Bindings for a given argument, handling default values and argument types.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Collects all argument Bindings for a FunctionSchema, including out and non-out arguments.
